title: Joined quadratic proof
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit, let $V$ be its quadratic variable count, and let $P=V+2^V+2^{V^2}$ be its quadratic proof length. Given a Boolean function on the $V$ extension-proof positions and a Boolean function on the $2^V+2^{V^2}$ inner-proof positions, their joined proof on the $P$ positions agrees with the extension function on the initial block and with the inner-proof function on the remaining block.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean-valued function on the quadratic variable positions
A Boolean-valued function on the inner-proof positions
